questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Mathematical Literacy Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Calculate the simple interest on R12 000 invested at 9% per annum for 2 years.
questions.explanation: Simple interest I = P × r × t = 12 000 × 0.09 × 2 = R2 160.

Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Mathematical Literacy Paper 1 · Question 4.1

On a distance-time graph, a horizontal line indicates …

options.text: the object is stationary
constant acceleration
speed is increasing
distance is zero

questions.explanation: Zero gradient on a distance-time graph means no change in distance — stationary.
